messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Paging: HIGH severity — embeddings-service errors across eu-west-1 and us-west-2. Error rate spike >40% for the last 3m. Pager routed to #incidents and @Sam (oncall). Logs: `503` from model-prefetcher. Runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/embeddings-failure

Sam (oncall): on it. pulling logs, rolling back last deploy in us-west-2 (deploy id: rwd-emb-v12). Will update in 10.

Priya (ops): thanks. quick ask: can you confirm if Dedicated customers on reserved pools were affected? need to know for SLA window.

Sam (oncall): preliminary: traffic spike + gc on prefetchers caused a backlog. Dedicated pools show increased latency but not 503s for most customers — one Dedicated pool (d-pool-7) had CPU throttling and returned 503s for ~7m. Hosted customers saw errors from the routing fallbacks for model-prefetch.

Jordan (eng): copying logs from us-west-2 node rwd-uw2-n12 to gist: https://internal/gists/emb-logs. Looks like async prefetch queue filled due to a regression in the batching adaptor introduced in rwd-emb-v12. Patch ready: revert batching adaptor change (PR 5421). Recommend rolling back everywhere, then monitor for 15m.

Sam (oncall): rolling back now in eu-west-1 and us-west-2. ETA 5m. Notifying platform autoscale to spin up additional prefetch workers as mitigation: `infractl scale worker-prefetch --count +3`.

IncidentBot: Deploy rollback started by Sam. 

Sam (oncall): rollback complete in eu-west-1 and us-west-2. Error rate dropped to ~2% after ~6m. Holding on further actions until stabilization for 15m.

Priya (ops): Good. We need to start impact assessment for SLA. Alicia (Billing) and Mike (CS) — FYI. Who calculates minutes of downtime per customer?

Alicia (Billing): will need a list of affected customers + time windows. If Dedicated customers experienced >5m outage that exceeded their SLA, we may owe credits per contract. Send me per-customer timeline and the service tier.

Mike (Customer Success): prepping a customer-facing note. Two customers already opened support tickets (Acme Corp, Nova Apps). Would like a short status update we can paste into support replies.

Jordan (eng): exporting timelines: affected windows: us-west-2: 2024-07-11T02:04Z — 2024-07-11T02:17Z (13m). eu-west-1: 2024-07-11T02:07Z — 2024-07-11T02:14Z (7m). Dedicated pool d-pool-7: 02:05Z — 02:12Z (7m) with 503s. Hosted customers saw degraded success rate until rollback finished (~13m window for some routes). Full timeline + per-route logs in the gist above.

Priya (ops): for SLA credit calc — use policy in /policies/sla-credits.md. Short summary: if outage >10m for hosted with paid tier, credit = prorated monthly usage for outage duration; Dedicated reserved contracts have separate credit multipliers. Alicia can confirm exact formula.

Alicia (Billing): confirming: for Hosted Standard (paid) we prorate based on minutes affected * monthly committed usage; for Dedicated we use the contract's uptime guarantee and credit formula. I'll compute rough numbers after I get the per-customer minutes. Please send CSV: customer_id, tier, start_ts, end_ts, duration_min.

Sam (oncall): exporting trace -> attached CSV to thread: `customers_impacted_1718201234.csv` (attached to internal ticket). Key point: Acme Corp (hosted-paid) 13m, Nova Apps (Dedicated) 7m, Beta Labs (hosted-free) 12m (free tier not eligible per policy).

Mike (Customer Success): Draft status page update (please edit): 

```
Status Update (Embeddings Service) — July 11
Summary: We observed an elevated error rate for the embeddings generation endpoint affecting some customers in eu-west-1 and us-west-2. A code regression in the batching adaptor caused prefetch queues to saturate. We rolled back the change and restored normal service.
Impact: Temporary failed requests and increased latency for customers in the listed regions; a subset of Dedicated customers experienced request failures.
Mitigation: Rollback of the recent change and temporary scale-up of prefetch workers.
Current status: Service stabilized; monitoring in progress.
```

Sam (oncall): looks good. Add estimated affected window and forgiveness statement: "Customers on paid plans affected for 13 minutes; we will evaluate SLA credits where applicable."

Mike (Customer Success): added. Template customer-facing message for Acme Corp: 

"Hi Acme team — we experienced an incident affecting embeddings in eu-west-1 between 02:04–02:17 UTC. This caused transient failed requests for your integration. We have rolled back the change and service is stable. We are evaluating eligibility for SLA credits and will follow up with any compensation by EOD. Let us know if you saw any persistent errors or logs to share."

Alicia (Billing): I ran a quick calc: Acme (hosted-paid) — 13m outage => estimated credit = 0.45% of monthly bill (rough), Nova Apps (Dedicated) — per contract credit estimated: one monthly service day equivalent / prorated => compute exact per their reserved commit; I'll post detailed amounts in 30m.

Priya (ops): we should also note whether this qualifies for auto SLA credit per policy (some credits are automatic for Hosted). Alicia, can you flag which ones we auto-apply vs need manual approval?

Alicia (Billing): yes. Auto credits: Hosted paid accounts that meet thresholds get auto-credited. Dedicated requires manual review + finance sign-off for larger credits. I'll tag items `auto-credit:true` in the CSV.

Jordan (eng): follow-up: opening PR to revert batching adaptor permanently + test coverage to prevent regressions (PR 5423). Also adding a guard in prefetch queue to reject new prefetch when backlog > threshold, to prevent cascade.

Sam (oncall): handoff in 15m to Jordan for overnight monitoring. Notes for oncall: watch for prefetch queue depth spikes, verify autoscale is active, and escalate if error rate >5% for >10m.

Jordan (eng): taking handoff. ping me for any late alerts.

IncidentBot: Handoff recorded: Sam -> Jordan. Next oncall rotation: 2024-07-11T18:00Z.

Mike (Customer Success): I'll send the customer messages now and tag support tickets. For Acme and Nova Apps: include apology, technical summary, and next steps on credits.

Alicia (Billing): posting final amounts: Acme (auto-credit applied) 0.45% on July invoice; Nova Apps requires manual credit, finance reviewed, approved 0.9% equivalent — billing action queued. I'll notify CS when issued.

Priya (ops): closing loop: leave incident open until 24h monitoring done and PR merged. We should draft the internal postmortem template now that we have timelines. Sam/Jordan, please add root cause and remediation in postmortem doc.

Sam (oncall): noted. I'll create the postmortem doc and include the exact timeline and mitigation steps. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
